## About
Hydra Fox Designs is a full-service digital agency offering branding, UX/UI design, web development, and digital marketing for startups and growing businesses.

## Services
- Branding: Brand strategy, brand identity, logo design, brand guidelines
- Design: UX design, UI design, product design
- Marketing: Digital marketing, social media, content strategy
- Web Development: Website development, e-commerce, web applications

## Industries Served
- Startups
- Home Decor Brands
- Real Estate Brands
- Food & Beverage Brands
